src: 5x5 block sprites s separated by full-row/full-col magenta dividers
dst: paste s into strip slots d (a 1×N strip with magenta dividers)
match_cond: s.right-edge fg rows == d.left-edge fg rows (horizontal chain) OR s.bottom-edge fg cols == d.top-edge fg cols (vertical chain); choose the orientation where a full chain exists
transform: translate s into the matched slot d (no rotation)
